subject: math
title: Count to 120: Count On, Read and Write Numbers
seo_title: Grade 1 Counting to 120 Worksheets: Count On, 120 Chart, Read and Write Numbers
domain: Number and Operations in Base Ten
standard_text: Count to 120, starting at any number less than 120. In this range, read and write numerals and represent a number of objects with a written numeral.
meta_desc: Free Grade 1 counting to 120 worksheets: count objects in rows of 10, say what comes next (59, 60 and 109, 110), fill in a 120 chart, read and write number words, and count past 100. 100 practice questions with an answer key and simple explanations.
key_big: Count on by 1s. After 9 ones comes a new ten: 59, 60 and 109, 110.
key_sub: 10 tens make 100. Then keep going: 101, 102 … 120. Write one hundred five as 105, not 1005.
body_html:
Counting to 120 means saying the numbers in order

You can start at any number and count on by 1s. Only the ones digit changes, until you get to 9 ones. Then 1 more makes a new ten.

Count onWhat happens
37, 38, 39, 409 ones and 1 more make a new ten
97, 98, 99, 10010 tens make one hundred
107, 108, 109, 110100 and 1 ten

Count objects in rows of 10

Put things in rows of 10. Count the full rows by 10s. Then count on the rest by 1s.

A rod is 10 cubes. 10 rods are 100 cubes.

The 120 chart

Each row has 10 numbers. Go right to count on 1. Go down to get 10 more.

What comes next?

58, 59, ☐

59 has 9 ones. 1 more makes a new ten, so 5 tens become 6 tens.

Answer: 60

Read and write numbers

WordNumber
sixteen16
forty-two42
one hundred five105
one hundred ten110

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Writing 510 after 599 ones and 1 more make a new ten: 60
Going back to 50 after 59Count on to the next ten: 59, 60
Writing 1005 for one hundred fiveWrite 105. The 0 means no tens
Writing 10010 for one hundred tenWrite 110
Writing 61 for sixteenTeen numbers start with 1: 16

faq.q: How high should a 1st grader count?
faq.a: By the end of Grade 1, children should count to 120. They should also start at any number, like 87, and count on from there.

faq.q: How do you teach counting past 100?
faq.a: Use a 120 chart and count 98, 99, 100, 101 out loud. Show that 101 to 120 work just like 1 to 20, with a 1 hundred in front.

faq.q: Why does my child write 1005 for 105?
faq.a: They write 100 and then 5, just as they hear it. Show that 105 is 1 hundred, 0 tens and 5 ones, so it has only three digits.
It is a grid with the numbers 1 to 120 in rows of 10. Moving right is 1 more and moving down is 10 more, so it helps children find missing numbers.

items.q: Count on: 14, 15, 16, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Count on by 1s. After 16 comes 17. 71 has the digits the wrong way.

items.q: Count on: 23, 24, 25, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Count on by 1s. After 25 comes 26. 27 skips a number.

items.q: Count on: 28, ☐, 30. What number is missing?
items.e: The missing number comes after 28 and before 30. After 28 comes 29.

items.q: Count back: 86, 85, 84, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Counting back, each number is 1 less. 84 − 1 = 83.

items.q: Count on: 46, 47, 48, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 48 comes 49. Only the ones digit goes up by 1.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?

items.q: What number comes just before 40?
items.e: Count back 1 from 40: 39. 41 comes just after 40.

items.q: Count on: 38, 39, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 39 comes 40. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten. So 3 tens become 4 tens. Do not write 310.

items.q: Count back: 63, 62, 61, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Counting back, each number is 1 less. 61 − 1 = 60. 59 skips a number.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?
items.e: Count back from 70: 69, 68, 67, 66. Or count on from 64: 65, 66.

items.q: Count on: 57, 58, 59, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 59 comes 60. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten. Do not go back to 50, and do not write 510.

items.q: Count on: 68, 69, ☐, 71. What number is missing?
items.e: After 69 comes 70, then 71. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten.

items.q: Count on: 77, 78, 79, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 79 comes 80. The 9 ones make a new ten with 1 more, so 7 tens become 8 tens.

items.q: What number comes just before 100?
items.e: Count back 1 from 100: 99. 101 comes just after 100.

items.q: Count on: 97, 98, 99, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 99 comes 100. 9 tens and 1 more ten make 10 tens. 10 tens is one hundred. Do not write 910.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?
Count on: 107, 108, 109, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: After 109 comes 110. 100 and 9 ones, plus 1 more, is 100 and 1 ten. Do not write 1010.

items.q: What number comes just before 110?
items.e: Count back 1 from 110: 109. Write 109, not 1009.

items.q: Count on: 112, 113, 114, ☐. What comes next?
items.e: Count on by 1s. After 114 comes 115.

items.q: Which number is “twelve”?
items.e: Twelve is 1 ten and 2 ones. Write 12.

items.q: How do you say 14?
items.e: 14 is 1 ten and 4 ones. Say fourteen. Forty is 40.

items.q: Which number is “sixteen”?
items.e: Sixteen is 1 ten and 6 ones. The 1 comes first: 16. 61 is sixty-one.

items.q: Which number is “thirty”?
items.e: Thirty is 3 tens and 0 ones. Write 30. 13 is thirteen.

items.q: How do you say 50?
items.e: 50 is 5 tens and 0 ones. Say fifty. Fifteen is 15.

items.q: Which number is “nineteen”?
items.e: Nineteen is 1 ten and 9 ones. Write 19. 91 is ninety-one.

items.q: Which number is “forty-two”?
items.e: Forty-two is 4 tens and 2 ones. Write 42, not 402.

items.q: How do you say 61?
items.e: 61 is 6 tens and 1 one. Say sixty-one. Sixteen is 16.

items.q: Which number is “fifty-eight”?
items.e: Fifty-eight is 5 tens and 8 ones. Write 58, not 508.

items.q: Which number is “seventy-three”?
items.e: Seventy-three is 7 tens and 3 ones. Write 73.

items.q: Which number is “ninety-nine”?
items.e: Ninety-nine is 9 tens and 9 ones. Write 99, not 909.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred”?
items.e: One hundred is 10 tens. Write 100: a 1 and two zeros.

items.q: Which number is the same as 10 tens?
How do you say 103?
items.e: 103 is 100 and 3 more. Say one hundred three. One hundred thirty is 130.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred five”?
items.e: One hundred five is 100 and 5 more. Write 105. The 0 shows there are no tens. Do not write 1005.

items.q: Which number is the same as 10 tens and 8 ones?
items.e: 10 tens is 100. 100 and 8 ones is 108. Write 108, not 1008.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred ten”?
items.e: One hundred ten is 100 and 1 ten. Write 110. Do not write 100 and then 10.

items.q: How do you say 115?
items.e: 115 is 100 and 15 more. Say one hundred fifteen. One hundred fifty is 150.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred seventeen”?
items.e: One hundred seventeen is 100 and 17 more. Write 117, not 10017.

items.q: Which number is “one hundred twenty”?
items.e: One hundred twenty is 100 and 2 tens. Write 120, not 10020.

items.q: Which list counts on by 1s?
items.e: After 99 comes 100, then 101. The right list is 98, 99, 100, 101.

items.q: Parking spots are in order. A red car is in spot 59. A blue car is in the next spot. What is the blue car’s spot?
items.e: After 59 comes 60. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten.

items.q: Each tick is 1 more. What number goes at the ?

items.e: Count on 1 from 106. The next step is 107.

items.q: Which number comes between 109 and 111?

items.e: Count on 1 from 110. She has 111 stickers.

items.q: Kai counts back: 102, 101, 100. What does he say next?
items.e: Counting back, each number is 1 less. Just before 100 is 99.

items.q: Tickets at the fair go 100, 101, 102 … Lily gets the ticket after 104. What is her number?
items.e: Count on 1 from 104. The number is 105. Write 105, not 1005.

items.q: Which list counts on by 1s?
items.e: After 109 comes 110, then 111. The right list is 108, 109, 110, 111.

items.q: Owen has 10 strings of beads. Each string has 10 beads. He has 3 more beads. How many beads does he have?

items.e: Count on 2 from 99: 100, 101. Do not count page 99.

items.q: Mia starts at 112 and counts on 5 more. Where does she stop?
items.e: Count 5 numbers after 112: 113, 114, 115, 116, 117. Do not count 112.

items.q: The class counts the days of school. Today is day 119. What day is tomorrow?
items.e: Count on 1 from 119. Tomorrow is day 120. 9 ones and 1 more make a new ten.

items.q: Emma’s book has 120 pages. Which page comes just before the last page?
items.e: The last page is 120. Count back 1 from 120. The page before it is 119.
